class.name: FellowWeather3D
class.brief_description: The weather: clear, cloudy, overcast, rain, a thunderstorm, snow or a blizzard, changing over time (FellowEngine).
class.description: One node sets the scene's weather and changes it smoothly ([method set_weather]). A weather is a state: the wind and its gusts, rain or snow and how hard it falls, lightning, the volumetric clouds' coverage and density, the sunlight that gets through the clouds, the sky's light, the fog and the temperature. The presets fill it in; setting a value of the state yourself makes the weather [constant WEATHER_CUSTOM]. The node drives the scene's [FellowWind3D], [FellowRain3D] and [FellowLightning3D] (the paths in the Nodes group, or the active ones, or the first in the current scene) and creates the ones it needs that are missing ([member create_missing]). It sets the volumetric clouds' coverage and density in place of the project settings (they must be on: [code]rendering/fellow/post/clouds/enabled[/code]), so that their shadows follow too, dims the sun on the scene's surfaces where the clouds cast no shadows (not in the sky, nor on the clouds, which stay lit from above), adds fog to the environment and scales its sky's light. It wets the ground in the rain and dries it after, covers it with falling snow and melts the snow above freezing (wetting it): the rain node's own [code]wetting_time[/code], [code]drying_time[/code], [code]snowing_time[/code] and [code]melting_time[/code], sped up by [member ground_speed]. Rain turning to snow (or back) eases off over the first half of the transition and the other sets in over the second. The node works only while the game runs, not in the editor; when it leaves the tree, the environment gets its own values back. Decision record [code]docs/decisions/0132-weather-controller.md[/code]. [codeblock] # A storm coming in over two minutes; thunder after each strike. $FellowWeather3D.set_weather(FellowWeather3D.WEATHER_STORM, 120.0) $FellowWeather3D.get_lightning_node().struck.connect(func(pos, dist): get_tree().create_timer(dist / 343.0).timeout.connect(play_thunder)) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_current_state
method.description: The state now (during a transition, between the two weathers): [code skip-lint]wind_speed[/code], [code skip-lint]gustiness[/code], [code skip-lint]precipitation[/code], [code skip-lint]intensity[/code], [code skip-lint]lightning_rate[/code], [code skip-lint]cloud_coverage[/code], [code skip-lint]cloud_density[/code], [code skip-lint]sunlight[/code], [code skip-lint]ambient_light[/code], [code skip-lint]fog_density[/code], [code skip-lint]temperature[/code].

method.name: get_lightning_node
method.description: The lightning node the weather drives (or created), or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_preset_state
method.description: A preset's state, as [method get_current_state] gives it.

method.name: get_rain_node
method.description: The rain node the weather drives (or created), or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_sun_node
method.description: The sun the clouds dim: [member sun_path], or the current scene's first [DirectionalLight3D] that lights it.

method.name: get_transition_progress
method.description: How far the transition in progress has gone, from 0 to 1 (1 when there is none).

method.name: get_wind_node
method.description: The wind node the weather drives (or created), or [code]null[/code].

method.name: has_control
method.description: Whether the weather drives this part of the scene ([member controls]).

method.name: set_weather
method.description: Turns to [param weather] over [param transition] seconds (negative: [member transition_time]; 0: at once). Before the node is ready the weather is taken at once. [constant WEATHER_CUSTOM] keeps the state's values and turns to them.

members.member: The sky's light — its ambient light and reflections, and the sky drawn: the environment's [member Environment.background_energy_multiplier] — relative to the environment's own.
The volumetric clouds' coverage, about the share of the sky they cover (in place of [code]rendering/fellow/post/clouds/coverage[/code]).
The volumetric clouds' density: denser clouds are darker underneath (in place of [code]rendering/fellow/post/clouds/density[/code]).
What the weather drives. The parts left out keep their own settings.

Creates the wind, rain and lightning nodes the weather needs when the scene has none (as internal children). A rain node it creates draws its drops as thin streaks ([member FellowRain3D.streak_width] 0.004 m).
The [WorldEnvironment] whose environment gets the weather's fog and sky light. Empty: the current camera's environment, or the world's.

The colour of the weather's fog, scaled by the sky's brightness (the environment's background energy, so dark at night). Where the environment has fog of its own, the weather's share of the fog takes this colour.
Exponential fog added to the environment's (per metre: about 3 / the visibility). The sky greys with it.
How many times faster the ground wets, dries, is covered and melts than the rain node's times (a game's compressed day).
The wind's gusts ([member FellowWind3D.gustiness]).
How hard it rains or snows, from 0 to 1 ([member FellowRain3D.rain]).
The [FellowLightning3D] to drive. Empty: the current scene's first.
Lightning strikes per minute ([member FellowLightning3D.strikes_per_minute]).
What falls: nothing, rain or snow.

With [member create_missing], creates every node the weather can drive when it starts, so that none is created (and its shaders compiled) when the weather first needs it. An idle rain node still keeps its shelter heightfield up to date around the camera.

The [FellowRain3D] to drive. Empty: the active one. The weather turns its [member FellowRain3D.wetness_follows_rain] and [member FellowRain3D.snow_follows_precipitation] off and sets its wetness and snow itself.

When the node is ready, the ground as the weather leaves it: wet in the rain, covered in snow while it snows below freezing, its water frozen below 0 °C and frosted under a clear sky when nothing falls. A project's own wet or snowy ground is kept.
The sun the clouds dim. Empty: the current scene's first [DirectionalLight3D] that lights the scene.

The share of the sun's light that reaches the scene's surfaces through the clouds, on average. The light's own energy is unchanged: the sky and the clouds stay lit by the full sun. While the volumetric clouds cast their own shadows ([code]rendering/fellow/post/clouds/shadows[/code]) they take its place and it is not applied.

Degrees Celsius. Falling snow settles at 1 °C and below; snow on the ground melts above 0 °C, in the rain node's [code]melting_time[/code] at 5 °C (faster when warmer, three times as fast in the rain). Below 0 °C the water on the ground freezes and, when nothing falls, hoarfrost forms (slower under clouds), both in the rain node's [code]freezing_time[/code] at -5 °C; above 0 °C they thaw (the frost at once in the rain). Below 0 °C the controller creates the rain node (without rain) for them.
Seconds a change of weather takes when none is given ([member weather] set, a state's value set).
The weather. Setting it turns to it over [member transition_time].
The [FellowWind3D] to drive. Empty: the active one.
The wind's speed in m/s ([member FellowWind3D.speed]).

signal.name: transition_finished
signal.description: The weather has finished turning to [param weather].

signal.name: weather_changed
signal.description: The weather began turning to [param weather].
